sourceChain: Pi openai-completions ensureToolCallBlock indexed accumulation and truthy id/name updates

drafts.body:
这个问题可以尝试绕开 `dsh-llm-deepseek` 的流式拼接器：让一个自带 transport 的 Pi Provider 负责 OpenAI-compatible SSE，再由 `pi2dsh` 把它注册成 DSH 原生模型 route。现成可试的是 `pi-provider-litellm`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-provider-litellm
export LITELLM_BASE_URL="<你的 OpenAI-compatible 服务根地址>"
export LITELLM_API_KEY="<你的 key>"
# 重启 dsh，再从模型选择器选择该 route
```

我对代码链做了逐段核对：该包通过 Pi 的 `createProvider + openAICompletionsApi` 自己接收 SSE；Pi 按 `tool_calls[].index` 保存同一个调用，并且只有在 `id/name` 为非空值时才更新，所以后续的 `name: ""` 不会覆盖首个有效名称。`pi2dsh` 检测到包带 `streamSimple` 后通过 DSH 的 `llm.registerAdapter` 注册 route，最终的非空 name/id 再进入 DSH 工具执行。

这条链在源码语义上能避开原帖指出的覆盖代码；我没有你的具体 DeepSeek 订阅/端点，尚未替你跑账号级 E2E。你如果愿意试一下，把脱敏后的错误和模型 ID 发到 https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/issues ，我会沿真实端点继续解决。

这个 `null` 覆盖问题可以尝试用 provider-owned transport 绕开，而不是继续经过会把 `null !== undefined` 当更新的 DSH adapter。安装 `pi-provider-litellm` 后，请求与 SSE 由 Pi 的 OpenAI-compatible transport 处理，再由 `pi2dsh` 注册成 DSH 原生 route：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-provider-litellm
export LITELLM_BASE_URL="https://opencode.ai/zen/go"   # 或你的代理根地址
export LITELLM_API_KEY="<你的 key>"
# 重启 dsh，选择 LiteLLM route 下的模型
```

源码链已经核对：`pi-provider-litellm` 使用 Pi 标准 `openAICompletionsApi`；解析器按 tool-call index 合并分片，只有 truthy 的 `id/name` 才写入 block，后续 `id:null, name:null` 不会覆盖首包值。`pi2dsh` 只把这个 transport 包装成 DSH `llm.registerAdapter` route，不会再把响应送回原帖那段 `translate.ts`。

我没有 OpenCode Go 订阅，当前结论是源码级可行、不是该账号端点的实测结论。欢迎直接试；如果仍失败，把脱敏 SSE 形状或错误贴到 https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/issues ，我来继续补齐。

There is a source-level alternate route that avoids both the affected DeepSeek translator and its empty block-end identity. A transport-owning Pi provider such as `pi-provider-litellm` can parse the OpenAI-compatible stream itself, while `pi2dsh` registers that provider as a native DSH LLM route:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-provider-litellm
export LITELLM_BASE_URL="<your gateway root URL>"
export LITELLM_API_KEY="<your key>"
# restart dsh and select the LiteLLM route
```

I audited the complete source path before suggesting this. `pi-provider-litellm` uses Pi's `createProvider` with `openAICompletionsApi`. Pi accumulates calls by `tool_calls[].index`, appends argument fragments, and only replaces the stored id/name when the incoming value is non-empty. A later `id: ""` or `name: null` therefore cannot erase the first valid identity. `pi2dsh` detects the provider's `streamSimple`, wraps it through `llm.registerAdapter`, and carries the finalized identity into DSH's tool block.

I do not have your gateway deployment or subscription, so this is source-audited rather than an account-level E2E claim. If you try it and still reproduce the failure, please post a redacted stream/error at https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/issues and I will follow the real response shape through the bridge.

这类“首包有 name/id，续包发 null 后覆盖”的问题，现有 Pi Provider 路线在代码上可以避开。可以让 `pi-provider-litellm` 自己处理 OpenAI-compatible SSE，再由 `pi2dsh` 注册为 DSH 原生模型 route：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-provider-litellm
export LITELLM_BASE_URL="<你的网关根地址>"
export LITELLM_API_KEY="<你的 key>"
# 重启 dsh 并选择对应模型
```

我已经审过四段实现：Provider 确实自带 `streamSimple`；它调用 Pi 标准 `openAICompletionsApi`；Pi 按 index 合并工具分片，并只接受非空 id/name 更新；pi2dsh 再通过 `llm.registerAdapter` 把最终工具身份送进 DSH。因此续包的 `null` 不会回到原帖指出的 `dsh-llm-deepseek/translate.ts` 覆盖路径。

我没有你使用的具体推理模型订阅/网关部署，所以先作为源码确认的可试方案提供。若实测仍失败，请把脱敏错误、模型 ID 和端点类型发到 https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/issues ，我会继续按真实响应修。

A usable alternate path is to let a transport-owning Pi provider parse the proxy's SSE instead of routing it through the affected `dsh-llm-deepseek` translator. `pi-provider-litellm` can be installed with `pi2dsh` and becomes a normal DSH model route:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-provider-litellm
export LITELLM_BASE_URL="<your LiteLLM/OneAPI/OpenAI-compatible gateway root>"
export LITELLM_API_KEY="<your key>"
# restart dsh and select that route
```

I checked the implementation before posting: the package owns a `createProvider + openAICompletionsApi` transport; Pi accumulates tool calls by stream index and updates the stored id/name only for non-empty incoming values; `pi2dsh` recognizes `streamSimple`, registers it through DSH `llm.registerAdapter`, and forwards the finalized non-empty tool identity. Thus continuation chunks containing `null` cannot erase the first valid name/id.

I do not have the gateway deployment used in this report, so this is a source-audited compatibility route rather than a live claim for that account. If it still fails on your endpoint, please send the redacted error/stream shape to https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/issues and I will trace and fix the concrete incompatibility.

notClaimed.reason: The provider supplies no id for the entire call. Pi retains an empty id and pi2dsh currently forwards it; the alternate provider route does not close this case.
The report demonstrates Codex materializing optional schema fields. Switching stream parsers does not remove those generated values or make DSH escalation validators accept null.
The screenshot shows PTC/Code Mode dispatch and module-syntax failures, not null/empty SSE identity overwrite. A provider transport is not a demonstrated solution.
